single.rationale: Guidewire shows compelling transformation economics: pivoting from loss-making license model to profitable subscription SaaS with dramatically improving cash generation (FCF up from -$48M to +$295M in 3 years), operating profitability achieved in FY2025, and strong revenue acceleration (22.6% growth). The mission-critical nature of core insurance systems creates high switching costs and defensible market position, though valuation appears elevated at 15.3x EV/revenue.
